title: The Sea Has Teeth
description:
A cold sea can conceal far more than ice and wreckage. Pack for the journey, and assume that the first strange shape beneath the water is a warning.

This is an introductory reading entry ONLY. It does not claim the dimension was entered, a boss was defeated, a relic was equipped, or any reward has been earned. Runtime-verified item/structure objectives will be authored later.

Field note: Bring a safe return method. Swimming deeper is not the same as being ready for the thing living below.
